## openship service env

Inspect, edit, and apply a service's environment variables

```text
openship service env [options] [command]
```

| Subcommand | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| [`get [options] <service>`](/docs/cli/reference/service/env#openship-service-env-get) | List a service's environment variables (secrets masked) |
| [`set [options] <service> <pairs...>`](/docs/cli/reference/service/env#openship-service-env-set) | Set a service's environment variables for one environment |
| [`inspect [options] <service>`](/docs/cli/reference/service/env#openship-service-env-inspect) | Show effective variables, their sources, and pending runtime changes (secrets masked) |
| [`reveal [options] <service> <keys...>`](/docs/cli/reference/service/env#openship-service-env-reveal) | Print explicitly selected secret values; requires service write access |
| [`delete\|unset [options] <service> <keys...>`](/docs/cli/reference/service/env#openship-service-env-delete) | Remove selected service overrides; inherited values become effective again |
| [`apply [options] <service>`](/docs/cli/reference/service/env#openship-service-env-apply) | Apply the saved environment to the active container through the engine's replacement and rollback workflow |

## openship service env apply

Apply the saved environment to the active container through the engine's replacement and rollback workflow

```text
openship service env apply [options] <service>
```

| Argument | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `service` | Service name or id |

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-p, --project <id\|slug\|name>` | Stack (project) id, slug, or name |

## openship service env delete

Remove selected service overrides; inherited values become effective again

```text
openship service env delete|unset [options] <service> <keys...>
```

| Argument | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `service` | Service name or id |
| `keys` | Override keys to remove |

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-p, --project <id\|slug\|name>` | Stack (project) id, slug, or name |
| `-e, --env <environment>` | Environment: production \| preview \| development (default: "production") |

## openship service env inspect

Show effective variables, their sources, and pending runtime changes (secrets masked)

```text
openship service env inspect [options] <service>
```

| Argument | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `service` | Service name or id |

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-p, --project <id\|slug\|name>` | Stack (project) id, slug, or name |
| `-e, --env <environment>` | Environment: production \| preview \| development |
| `--runtime` | Inspect the running container to check whether saved values are applied |

## openship service env reveal

Print explicitly selected secret values; requires service write access

```text
openship service env reveal [options] <service> <keys...>
```

| Argument | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `service` | Service name or id |
| `keys` | Variable keys to reveal |

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-p, --project <id\|slug\|name>` | Stack (project) id, slug, or name |
| `-e, --env <environment>` | Environment: production \| preview \| development |
| `--source <source>` | Read saved effective values or the live container (choices: "effective", "runtime", default: "effective") |
| `--container <id>` | Expected container ID when reading runtime values |

## openship service env set

Set a service's environment variables for one environment

```text
openship service env set [options] <service> <pairs...>
```

| Argument | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `service` | Service name or id |
| `pairs` | KEY=VALUE pairs |

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `-p, --project <id\|slug\|name>` | Stack (project) id, slug, or name |
| `-e, --env <environment>` | Environment: production \| preview \| development (default: "production") |
| `--secret` | Mark the provided variables as secret |
| `--replace` | Replace ALL variables for this environment with only the given pairs |
